exactDirectorResponse:
YES — SH333-R02-OBLIGATION-REVISION-01.

This ruling binds request commit c0fd56baa4fcba6238d5fe6f083b892c62918dbe, 6,205 bytes, SHA-256 d2b9e43a5c2f56551aeafc37e51ed03919b6fe00311b3dfd7ad36a9950932458. I verified the request and all three source bindings.

For SH333-R02’s static authored-procedure review only, an owner-adopted abstract eligibility-loss test may replace the requirement to demonstrate an acquired, paid type-changing provider. This changes the review obligation; it does not create a game mechanic or establish such a provider.

The revised obligation requires a complete conditional witness demonstrating:
1. Explicit initial state: R02-TEST-RECIPIENT is Undead with an active Decay relay and an unexecuted order. Record controller/source IDs, reservations, guard history, costs, HP/maxima/modifiers, equipment/custody, schedules and deadlines. Numeric operands must be explicit and source-consistent.
2. Eligibility loss: a labeled TEST_ONLY input changes classification to non-Undead. Immediately end the affected relay, cancel its order and clear its reservation. Preserve already-paid costs and spent guards; an unexecuted order does not newly spend a guard.
3. Correct settlement: restore agency prospectively; recompute only source-bound eligibility-dependent modifiers. Demonstrate any required downward HP clamp without damage or healing. Preserve unrelated relations, parent source, clocks, resources, body and property.
4. No revival: a later conditional return to Undead must not restore the cancelled relation/order, refill budgets or create an opportunity. Record ordered before/after states and forward/inverse operations. Reverse replay is verification, not gameplay resurrection or refund.

Proposed owner adoption wording:
“I adopt the conditional TEST_ONLY inputs in request SHA-256 d2b9e43a5c2f56551aeafc37e51ed03919b6fe00311b3dfd7ad36a9950932458 under SH333-R02-OBLIGATION-REVISION-01, for construction and submission of SH333-R02-R1 only. This permits an explicit synthetic baseline, an abstract Undead-to-non-Undead eligibility-loss input, and a later return to Undead solely to test cancellation and non-revival. The witness must demonstrate immediate relay/order cancellation, reservation release without refund or new guard expenditure, prospective agency restoration, source-bound modifier recalculation and any downward HP clamp without healing, preservation of unrelated state and histories, and no stale-order revival or budget refresh. Exact timing, before/after states and forward/inverse operations must be recorded. This adoption supplies no operational provider, acquisition, paid activation or campaign history. Actual-provider qualification remains unresolved. It authorizes no seal, blocker closure, identity acceptance/application, canon or queue change.”

No witness has been constructed in this review, and no owner adoption is inferred. Separate explicit owner adoption is still required before construction. SH202-B03 remains held; authority remains 832 applied / 16 pending / 0 accepted-unapplied, with Final Word first.
